SI_MER_ONE_SPLMASH: Strikes the enemy two times, in rapid succession.

SI_MER_SUP_SMITEAXE: Increases your Defense Rate and Striking Power of an axe.
SI_MER_SUP_IMPOWERWEAPON: Strengthens the elemental damage of a weapon.
SI_MER_ONE_REFLEXHIT: This skill absorbs one attack and releases back at an enemy.
SI_KNT_SUP_GUARD: Increases defense rate. Lowers accuracy rate. Requires a two-handed weapon.
SI_KNT_SUP_PAINREFLECTION: Reflects a part of the damage received by an enemy.
SI_KNT_SUP_RAGE: Increases striking power. Lowers HP rate. Requires a two-handed weapon.
SI_KNT_TWO_POWERSWING: To strike a blow at the enemy by flourishing a weapon. Requires a two-handed weapon.
SI_KNT_TWOAX_PAINDEALER: Powerful, downward strike. Lowers the defense of the target. Requires two-handed axe.
SI_KNT_TWOAX_POWERSTUMP: Pounds the ground, stunning nearby enemies. Requires two-handed axe.
SI_BLD_DOUBLE_ARMORPENETRATE: Strikes at the enemy and lowers its defense.
SI_BLD_DOUBLESW_SILENTSTRIKE: A fast, sliding strike. Requires two weapons.
SI_BLD_DOUBLESW_BLADEDANCE: Strikes at multiple enemies. Requires two swords.
SI_BLD_DOUBLEAX_SPRINGATTACK: Strikes at an enemy multiple times. Requires two axes.
SI_BLD_DOUBLEAX_HAWKATTACK: Powerful, downward strike. Small chance to blind the target. Requires two axes.
SI_BLD_DOUBLE_SONICBLADE: Powerful, slashing attack. Requires two weapons.
SI_ASS_HEAL_HEALING: Recover the HP of a target.
SI_ASS_HEAL_PATIENCE: Increase the Max. HP of a target for a limited time.
SI_ASS_HEAL_PREVENTION: Target recovers HP when it reaches below a certain point.
SI_ASS_CHEER_HEAPUP: Increases the physical strength of the target.
SI_ASS_CHEER_CANNONBALL: Increases the DEX of the target.
SI_ASS_CHEER_CIRCLEHEALING: Heals party members close to you.
SI_ASS_CHEER_BEEFUP: Increases striking power of a target.
SI_ASS_KNU_BURSTCRACK: Pounds the ground and damages enemies around you.
SI_ASS_CHEER_STONEHAND: All attacks gain the chance to stun.
SI_ASS_CHEER_QUICKSTEP: Increases the walk speed of a target.
SI_ASS_CHEER_CATSREFLEX: Increases the block rate of a target.
SI_ASS_CHEER_ACCURACY: Increases the accuracy of a target.
SI_ASS_CHEER_HASTE: Increases attack speed of a target.
SI_RIN_HEAL_HEALRAIN: Recovers HP for party members near you.
SI_RIN_SUP_HOLYCROSS: Target enemy takes double damage for a limited time.
SI_RIN_SUP_HOLYGUARD: Increases your defense against ranged and melee attacks.
SI_RIN_SQU_GEBURAHTIPHRETH: This ability draws upon the inner strength of nearby party members, Increases your Stats.
SI_RIN_SUP_MERKABAHANZELRUSHA: Enemies take damage in an area around you.
SI_BIL_KNU_PIERCINGSERPENT: Fires a piercing beam at the target.
SI_BIL_KNU_BLOODFIST: Strikes a heavy blow to the enemy that causes it to lose health over time.
SI_BIL_PST_BARAQIJALESNA: Increases striking power while decreasing defensive power
SI_BIL_PST_BGVURTIALBOLD: Strikes at nearby enemies with an outward shockwave.
SI_MAG_FIRE_BOOMERANG: Strikes at the enemy with a ball of flame.
SI_MAG_FIRE_HOTAIR: Damages the enemy continuously with a geyser of flame.
SI_MAG_WIND_STRONGWIND: Ranged, wind attack that moves the enemy.
SI_MAG_WATER_ICEMISSILE: Blasts the enemy with a missile of ice.
SI_MAG_ELECTRICITY_LIGHTINGBALL: Damages the enemy with a ball of static.
SI_MAG_EARTH_SPIKESTONE: Damages an enemy with a stone spike. Chance to stun the enemy.
SI_MAG_FIRE_FIRESTRIKE: Damages an enemy with a fire ball. The enemy loses health for a limited time afterwards.
SI_MAG_WATER_WATERBALL: A water attack that shoots multiple water orbs at your target.  The amount and strength of the orbs increases based on the skill level.
SI_MAG_WATER_SPRINGWATER: Splashes the enemy with a water attack. The enemy takes damage over time.
SI_MAG_ELECTRICITY_LIGHTINGPARM: Damages the enemy with an electric ball
SI_MAG_ELECTRICITY_LIGHTINGSHOCK: Damages the enemy with a small but fast lightning ball.
SI_MAG_EARTH_ROCKCRASH: Damages the enemy with a giant stone.
SI_PSY_NLG_DEMONOLGY: Damages the enemy with a mental blast.
SI_PSY_PSY_PSYCHICBOMB: Damages the enemy the with a ball of mental energy.
SI_PSY_PSY_PSYCHICWALL: Creates a wall that pushes an enemy back and damages them if they touch it.
SI_PSY_PSY_SPRITBOMB: Does damage to an enemy based on your remaining MP amount.
SI_PSY_NLG_CRUCIOSPELL: Deals damage to an enemy equal to twice the amount the enemy deals.
SI_PSY_PSY_MAXIMUMCRISIS: Surrounds and damages the enemy in a strong mental barrier.
SI_PSY_PSY_PSYCHICSQUARE: Damages the enemies around you with a psychic blast.
SI_ELE_FIRE_FIREBIRD: Damages the enemy with a fire blast.
SI_ELE_FIRE_BURINGFIELD: Does damage to the enemy over a period of time
SI_ELE_ELECTRICITY_THUNDERSTRIKE: Damages the enemy with a bolt of lightning.
SI_ELE_ELECTRICITY_ELETRICSHOCK: Damage surrounding enemies with electricity. Defense of the enemies decreases.
SI_ELE_EARTH_STONESPEAR: Damages an enemy with a stone spear.
SI_ELE_WATER_ICESHARK: Ranged attack that fires an ice projectile.
SI_ELE_WATER_WATERMASTER: Increases your Melee and Range block rate.
SI_ELE_WATER_POISONCLOUD: Damages enemies in the surrounding area.
SI_ELE_WIND_VOID: To attack the enemy by generating a perfect vacuum.
SI_ELE_WIND_WINDFIELD: Damages surrounding enemies with a wind attack. The speed of the enemies will be reduced.
SI_ELE_MULTY_METEOSHOWER: Damages surrounding enemies with a falling meteor.
SI_ELE_MULTY_LIGHTINGSTORM: Damages surrounding enemies with electric blasts.
SI_ELE_MULTY_SANDSTORM: Damages surrounding enemies with a sandstorm.
SI_ELE_MULTY_AVALANCHE: Damages surrounding enemies with a snowstorm.
SI_ACR_SUP_YOYOMASTER: Increases damage done with a Yo-yo.
SI_ACR_SUP_BOWMASTER: Increases damage done with a Bow.
SI_ACR_SUP_DARKILLUSION: Become Invisible for a short time.
SI_ACR_SUP_FASTWALKER: Increases walk speed for a short time
SI_ACR_BOW_AIMEDSHOT: Slow shot that has a chance to deal double damage.
SI_ACR_BOW_SILENTSHOT: A surprise attack that does more damage during Dark Illusion.
SI_ACR_BOW_ARROWRAIN: Creates a rain of arrows that does damage over time.
SI_ACR_YOYO_CROSSLINE: A Yo-yo strike that can cause stun.
SI_ACR_BOW_AUTOSHOT: Rapid shot that can blind an enemy.
SI_ACR_YOYO_SNITCH: Steal penya from a target while in Dark Illusion. Attack from behind.

SI_JST_YOYO_VATALSTAB: Surprise attack while in Dark Illusion.
SI_RAG_BOW_ICEARROW: Slows an enemy down by shooting it with arrows covered in ice.
SI_RAG_BOW_FLAMEARROW: Gives the fire element to arrows and damages surrounding enemies.
SI_RAG_BOW_POISONARROW: Adds poison damage to Bow and increase your striking damage.
